newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest dull.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest dull.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Thursday after early falls as buying interest remained thin, traders said.

They said olein was quoted at 1,395-1,400 rupiah/kg in Jakarta. A 3,000-tonne crude palm oil tender was done earlier on Thursday in the North Sumatran city of Medan, with deliveries taking place over three weeks in batches of 1,000 tonnes each.

The first consignment, to be delivered next week, was done at 1,210 rupiah/kg, including tax and transportation costs, and the second at 1,204.4 rupiah. The final consignment was done at 1,201 rupiah. The previous tender price was 1,222 rupiah/kg.
Traders said fresh olein shipments, including one of 5,000 tonnes believed to be imported by state logistics agency BULOG from Malaysia, were set to arrive in Jakarta.
They said olein was expected to remain under pressure on Friday, but they said the downside was limited.
"With the relatively high price of crude palm oil, I don't see olein prices declining substantially," one said.
